message.content: On slow 3G the checkout button flickers and some people manage to place the order twice. Fix it.

content.thinking: The button is never disabled, so a second tap during the request fires submit again. The flicker is the label swapping to a spinner, which changes the button width. Disable while pending, guard with a ref (state updates are async, two fast taps both see loading=false), and keep the width fixed.

content.content: The file src/components/CheckoutButton.tsx has been updated.

content.text: The button is disabled while the order is pending, a ref blocks a second tap that lands before the re-render, and a fixed min-width stops the flicker when the label swaps to the spinner.

input.command: git commit -am "Disable checkout button while the order is pending"
